title: Heavens Block - Probably most annoying block to get
body:
This mod adds a block that is... **Very hard to obtain**. This mod is recommended to play with JEI as its easier to find the recipes. It also has multiple advancments for progression.
Obtainment method:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

First you need to find a structure on the stony shores that looks like a house called the Fisherman HHouse. ![HHouse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f8a4333baf0e906a329ffcbf4925ffd367d126c.png)
In there you can find the H ore. Mining it with a diamond pickaxe gives you the H gem. With the H gem you can put the gem in a brewing stand and a flint and steel below to make an H Flint and Steel![H flint and steel recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2795eb5c3107524484879721392519cb194ab5f.png)
Then you craft 14 Procedure TP's, build a nether like portal and light with the H Flint and Steel.![recipe for Procedure TP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/214fcd5af570a8d2614aae12d0e9e748ad10b1dc.png)
![Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f524ed95501666b67bb4bd357ff88368062ea34.png)
When you reach the dimension you need to go ontop of the bedrock roof and find these stone structures.![Stone structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/997957648903c5a872f4e3b7985cc1221a3a1953.png)
In there is a small chance you can find an H gem or a Procedure Ore(Mined with diamond pickaxe). The procedure ore drops 3 Raw Procedure Ore and can then be smelted into an procedure gem. These procedure gems are necessary for crafting the Heavens Edge. ![Recipe for Heavens Edge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11b2f21705f475ce25e0e2c095609d27f096d1b0.png)
This item is just another step in the making of the Heavens Block. Which is crafted with 3 H Blocks and 2 H gems. On the corners are the Heavens Edges.![Heavens Block Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dc6762a4ffef5133cdbcd864fd452c2f7a1f495.png)
There is an advancment for getting an H gem, entering the Procedure dimension, obtaining the Heavens Block and obtaining a stack(64) of the Heavens Block which is just... **EXTREMELY UNNECESSARY.** Like the rest of the whole mod. 

</details>

### **Good luck**
